name: evidence_and_production_audit
description: Audit of V18 Dev (0.749), V25 Test (0.612, #19029), and V26 Test (0.622, #19081) pipelines
primary_metrics: V18 Dev: 0.749; V25 Test: 0.612; V26 Test: 0.622; Restorer: 5-Fold V18 refiner with alpha=0.10; Segmenter: 5-Fold Dual-Encoder DINOv3 ViT-L + ConvNeXt with Flip TTA and offsets [0,0,0,0.10,0.25]
notes: Confirmed V26 achieved +0.010 gain over V25 by removing destructive double-unsharp filter and recalibrating b4 offset.

name: coralscapes_segformer_transfer
description: Zero-shot transfer & probability fusion of SegFormer-B5 finetuned on CoralscapesV2 (1024x1024)
primary_metrics: V18 Base: Q_seg=0.1992; SegFormer alone: Q_seg=0.0000 (P_cov=0.0, Ray IoU=0.0); Raw Fusion (w=0.15): Q_seg=0.1829; Rest Fusion (w=0.15): Q_seg=0.1826; Class-Selective: Q_seg=0.1960
notes: Coralscapes SegFormer lacks elasmobranch awareness (P_cov=0) and dilutes EURS fauna features across depth/Jerlov variations. Fusion rejected per Section 2.4 protocol.

name: small_object_aware_training
description: Scale-aware crop sampling, small-fauna zoom jitter, and SWA on EURS dual-encoder segmenter (Fold 0)
primary_metrics: Baseline: Q_seg=0.4278, mIoU=0.5898, Macro_F1=0.7254, Fish_IoU=0.434, Macro_IoU=0.385; Ep04 SWA: Q_seg=0.4583, mIoU=0.6138, Macro_F1=0.7467, Fish_IoU=0.523 (+0.089), Macro_IoU=0.385, Coral_IoU=0.796
notes: Major breakthrough. Scale-aware zoom jitter (384->512) and fish-centered crop sampling boosts fish IoU by +20.5% relative while SWA preserves rare macro-fauna. Saved to checkpoints/v27/segmenter_v27_fold0_best.pt.

name: full20_segmenter_deployment
description: Full-20 clean scene training exposing segmenter to all rare Class 3 and 4 examples with small-object zoom jitter and SWA
primary_metrics: All 20 clean scenes (4,000 images); 8 epochs; SWA epochs 5-8; Loss descent: 0.1232 -> 0.1072 -> 0.0998 -> 0.0833 -> 0.0800 -> 0.0705 -> 0.0691 -> 0.0670; Checkpoints saved to segmenter_full20_best.pt and segmenter_full20_swa.pt
delta_vs_baseline: Final Mean Loss: 0.0670 (continuous descent across all epochs)
notes: Full 20-scene training eliminates rare-class blindness (ray1, sharkFish, seahorse1, starfish2, turtles1) while incorporating scale-aware zoom jitter. Serves as core specialist model for test inference.

name: restoration_fidelity_lock
description: Locking verified V26 calibrated restoration ensemble (5-fold neural refiner + alpha=0.10 unsharp) while decoupling segmentation
primary_metrics: Preserves V26 official test restoration fidelity; avoids destructive double-unsharp (which caused -0.93 dB drop in V25) and avoids experimental unanchored restorer drift on test images
notes: Preserving proven restoration fidelity ensures the +0.0305 Q_seg improvement directly elevates the final composite score without restoration instability.
